data.name: Badeeah
data.gender_notes: Badeeah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'badadh', which means 'to sow, plant'. In Islamic context, it refers to the one who nurtures, cultivates and grows. The name Badeeah is associated with the righteous wife of Prophet Hud, who was known for her perseverance and faithfulness. The name Badeeah carries the meaning “Gardener, Sower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Badeeah usually hope their child will grow to embody gardener, sower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes nurturing, growth, and perseverance in faith.
data.etymology: Badeeah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gardener, Sower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Badeeah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
